name: payments-lexe
description: Opt-in Lightning payments with Lexe for fresh/unpinned profiles. Existing wallet-lexe pins require separate identity-checked adoption. Startup can provision a mainnet wallet; fresh profiles default to free-only.

name: payments-nwc
description: Opt-in Lightning payments with an existing NWC wallet. Requires a private connection URI file and mainnet wallet permissions; fresh profiles default to free-only.

name: payments-ldk-server
description: Proposed Lightning payments with LDK Server. Wallet release and archive pins pending; requires existing server credentials. Fresh profiles default to free-only.
